pages.text: Gauss rifle: 5 damage, 32 blocks, gauss rounds. Right-click fires where you aim; walls stop the shot.
Sniper rifle (the ghost's): 16 damage (+5 against light), 64 blocks, canister rounds.
Punisher grenade launcher (the marauder's): grenades of 8 (+8 against armored) that slow what they hit. Punisher grenades: 8 from gunpowder, iron and a mineral shard.
P-38 Scythe pistols (the reaper's): two shots of 3 at once, 18 blocks, gauss rounds. KD8 charge: thrown, a blast of 4 that throws back everything round it; blocks stay.
Psi blade (the zealot's): a protoss blade sharper than diamond, mended with protoss armor shards.
Marshals in villages sell rounds, grenades, KD8 charges and the guns themselves for emeralds.
